title: City Council Regular Meeting
motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the ordinance amending the general plan from MDR to MHDR on the southern portion of the property, on the southside of the road, and leave the MDR on the northern side of the road. A discussion took place regarding how the motion changes the request. Mr. Whitehead noted if the general plan stays the same, they will continue with the R-3 zoning and not request PD-R as there would be no incentive for them to change the zone to a planned development. Currently, they are looking at 18-19 dwelling units per acre. Community Development Director John Willis explained the PD-R zone refers to the general plan giving the Council the discretion to approving density within the allowed range. Councilmember Larkin withdrew her motion.
result: No vote recorded (superseded)
